Welcome to the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
Previous
Next
From low observable technology to guidance, navigation, and control, to the forefront of cyber operations, the faculty, staff, and graduate students in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering are dedicated to the advancement of science and engineering in support of the Air Force mission ... and we do that quite well!
We invite you to browse through the information contained in this website and familiarize yourself with our degree programs and courses. Contact information and application procedures are presented on this website. We look forward to working with you!
